name: Samsung Galaxy Tab A7 LTE (SM-T505)

boot.kernel_cmdline: console=ttyMSM0,115200n8 earlycon=msm_geni_serial,0x4a90000 androidboot.console=ttyMSM0 androidboot.hardware=qcom androidboot.memcg=1 msm_rtb.filter=0x237 service_locator.enable=1 swiotlb=2048 loop.max_part=7 firmware_class.path=/lib/firmware/postmarketos audit=0

requirements: Build or explicitly supply the patched device kernel, DTBs and exactly matching modules.
Supply matching stock firmware, including early touchscreen firmware; it is absent from the public source repository.
Port the Qualcomm subsystem, QRTR, PD mapper, WLAN, Bluetooth, audio, modem and sensor startup services to Debian.
Rebuild the private KGSL Turnip and patched Zink libraries against glibc before enabling an accelerated desktop.
Provide and test initramfs root discovery and Samsung Android v2 boot packaging.
Audit kernel configuration and systemd service restrictions on Linux 4.19.
Revalidate all hardware on Debian; upstream postmarketOS results do not establish Debian functionality.
